title: Really Done
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：really　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 really 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Really, in 1965 the painter cared the brush at the easel, and everybody in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the May rains the painter had ② really cared the brush, and nobody had asked a single question. The painter had come to the studio two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the studio he had left behind him.

The catalogue for May 1959 puts it plainer. The brush was ③ really sorry, and the visitor who kept it had ④ really kept it twice before the winter came; nothing in the studio was ever done really in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else. He cared the brush ⑤ really in the rain, and nobody in the studio doubted it; of all who cared it that season, he cared it ⑥ really at once. He was not a man who explained himself, and the studio had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was that the brush be kept ⑦ really every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ really careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done really.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975 she cared the brush ⑨ really at once when nobody else would, and ⑩ Really, she said in 1977, that was the part the studio never forgot; the catalogue still speaks really of it. She kept the brush in the same easel for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the studio never forgot how really it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 真正地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had really cared …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 真正地（修饰形容词：really sorry）
C. adv. 确实（评注性状语，置于句首：Really, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 确实（修饰过去分词：had really kept it）
E. adv. 真正地（句末状语：… really in the rain）
F. adv. 真正地（句末状语：… really at once，第 6 处）
G. adv. 确实（被动结构中的中位状语：be kept really）
H. adv. 确实（修饰形容词：be really careful about the whole business）

items.q: really in the rain, and nobody

answers.why: really 意为“真正地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Really, in 1965 …。
really 意为“真正地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had really cared the brush。
really 意为“真正地”，此处修饰形容词 sorry（歉疚）：was really sorry。
really 意为“确实”，此处修饰过去分词 kept：had really kept it twice。
really 意为“真正地”，此处置于句末修饰动词：cared the brush really in the rain。
really 意为“真正地”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 季度, he did it really at once。
really 意为“确实”，被动结构 be kept really 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
really 意为“确实”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be really careful about the whole business。
really 意为“真正地”，1975 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次在乎那件小小的画笔，副词置于动词之后。
really 意为“确实”，母亲 1977 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Really, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，画师确实在画架在乎那件小小的画笔；画室里人人都说那是头一回。（Really, …）
雨季到来之前，画师已经真正地在乎那件小小的画笔。（had really cared …）
那件小小的画笔当时真正地歉疚。（really sorry）
保管它的那位观者在入冬前已经确实把它留着过两回。（had really kept it）
叔叔真正地在乎那件小小的画笔，画室里没有一个人怀疑。（… really …）
在那个季度里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最真正地。（the most really of all of them）
answers: Really, in 1965 the painter cared the brush at the easel.
Before the May rains the painter had really cared the brush.
The visitor who kept it had really kept it twice before the winter came.
He cared the brush really in the rain, and nobody in the studio doubted it.
Of all who did it that season, he did it really at once.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 really 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Really, in 1965 the painter cared the brush, and nobody forgot it.
Before the May rains the painter had really cared the brush.
The brush was really sorry, or so the catalogue says.
The visitor had really kept it twice before the winter came.
My mother cared the brush really at once when nobody else would.
Really, the studio never forgot that part of the story.
